propositions: Jira workflows may forbid direct end-state transitions, causing outbound sync to fail when intermediate hops are required (e.g., open->done when only open->in_progress->done is allowed).
Recorded status events in *-STATUS.json files contain the chronological sequence of transitions taken, which can be replayed to work around workflow restrictions.
Replay resumes from the current Jira issue status by matching it in Jira-name space without inverting LOCAL_STATUS_TO_JIRA, avoiding ambiguity from non-injective mappings.

Replay calls transition_issue_by_name once per remaining hop in order; if any hop raises RuntimeError (Cloud), ValueError/IllegalTransitionError (DC), or HTTPError, replay aborts and falls through to comment-fallback with drift.
The replay call site is in _update_one_scalar_update, which requires adding a local_id parameter to receive the mutation's local_id and pass it to the replay helper.
Replay is skipped when local_id is absent, preserving existing comment-fallback behavior.
